careerSummary.headline: Building Enterprise Cloud Platforms That Scale
careerSummary.summary: Infrastructure leader with 12 years architecting cloud solutions and 20 years in technology. Currently directing cloud infrastructure at First Citizens Bank (formerly Silicon Valley Bank), where I lead initiatives in platform engineering, FinOps optimization, and enterprise-scale Kubernetes deployments.
highlights: Directing cloud infrastructure strategy for a major financial institution
Expert in AWS, Kubernetes, and the CNCF ecosystem
Proven track record of building and leading high-performing engineering teams
Focus on platform engineering, developer experience, and cost optimization

experience.title: Director of Cloud Infrastructure
experience.description: Leading cloud infrastructure strategy and platform engineering for enterprise banking operations. Driving innovation in Kubernetes adoption, FinOps practices, and developer experience.
achievements: Architected and implemented enterprise Kubernetes platform serving 200+ microservices
Established FinOps practice achieving 30% reduction in cloud spend
Led migration of legacy workloads to containerized architecture
Built and mentored a team of 12 cloud engineers
Implemented GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and Flux

experience.title: Senior DevOps Architect
experience.description: Led DevOps transformation for one of the fastest-growing automotive e-commerce companies. Architected scalable CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
achievements: Designed and implemented CI/CD platform processing 500+ deployments daily
Migrated monolithic applications to microservices architecture
Reduced deployment time from hours to minutes through automation
Established infrastructure as code practices using Terraform

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
experience.description: Led DevOps initiatives for a media streaming platform, focusing on scalability and reliability for global content delivery.
achievements: Built auto-scaling infrastructure supporting millions of concurrent streams
Implemented monitoring and alerting stack using Prometheus and Grafana
Established disaster recovery procedures with 99.99% uptime SLA
